title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds 64,366 after a flat US close, down 0.3 percent amid dominant fear. The index sits at 29 as sentiment stays defensive. Hashrate remains steady at 794 exahashes, signaling miner resilience. Mempool backs up to 89,000 transactions with fees at 1 sat per vbyte, keeping costs low. Block 961,364 just cleared. Overnight, track any fear gauge rebound or sudden hashrate drop that could spark volatility into Asia open.
